mapper.select: SELECT id, product_name AS productName, price, stock, status, remark, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM products ORDER BY id
SELECT id, product_name AS productName, price, stock, status, remark, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM products WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( product_name, price, stock, status, remark ) VALUES ( #{productName}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET product_name = #{productName}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE products SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE products SET stock = stock + #{delta}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND stock + #{delta} >= 0
